summary: Iteration 2 testing for RAWDJA / The Needle Drop teacher-gated edition. 15/15 pytest backend tests passed (root, stats, certificate issuance + chaining, verify valid/invalid/founder, ledger integrity, teacher unlock 200/403, teacher content with/without JWT 200/401, teacher PDF with/without JWT 200/401 + %PDF magic, public student PDF download). Frontend Playwright passed end-to-end: /teachers-guide locked gate -> invalid serial shows teacher-unlock-error and stays locked -> valid founder serial RAWDJA-2026-00001-QQ2EDR unlocks teachers-guide-page with tg-lesson-0..5 + tg-objectives + tg-discussion + tg-glossary + tg-resources + tg-editorial -> teacher-download-pdf triggers The-Needle-Drop-Teachers-Edition.pdf -> teacher-lock-btn returns to gate. /downloads: download-student fetches PDF without auth; download-teacher (locked) shows text 'Unlock to download' and navigates to /teachers-guide on click. /certificate: label is 'Your full DJ name' with placeholder 'e.g. Jason Theory', issuing renders certificate-card; verify tab shows Authentic for founder serial and Not verified for fake serial. /print/teacher redirects to /teachers-guide; /print/student still renders. Bonus chapter /chapter/corporate-vs-real shows 'Goblin Mode' content and chapter-prev nav.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS still uses allow_origins=os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',') with default '*'; allow_credentials is now False so the browser combo is OK, but for production set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to known origins.

server.py: JWT_SECRET is read from .env (good), but expiry handling on the frontend (lib/teacher.js) should also detect 401 'Access expired' responses and auto-clear localStorage so the gate re-appears without a manual lock click. Currently observed only via lock button.
server.py: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.

teacher_content.py: server-side content is good (real gating). Consider versioning the guide (e.g., 'guide_version': 'v1') in /api/teacher/content so future updates can be cached/invalidated by clients.

Downloads.jsx: locked teacher card uses navigation to /teachers-guide on click — good UX. Consider adding a small hint that the unlock requires a certificate serial (so user knows the next step before navigating).
test_credentials: No login. Teacher's Edition unlock uses certificate SERIAL. Verified valid founder serial: RAWDJA-2026-00001-QQ2EDR (name 'Jason Theory', seq=1).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest issued TEST_-prefixed certificates (TEST_Chainer One/Two, TEST_VerifyMe, TEST_LedgerCheck). Frontend run also issued one TEST_UI Jane DJ certificate via the UI. Ledger is append-only, so these remain in MongoDB by design. Founder serial RAWDJA-2026-00001-QQ2EDR is intact and unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founder cert RAWDJA-2026-00001-QQ2EDR (seq=1, name 'Jason Theory') is the canonical unlock key for the Teacher's Edition. JWT scope 'teacher', 12h expiry, stored in localStorage 'rawdja_teacher_token'. Pytest suite covers: cert ledger + chaining, teacher gate (unlock 200/403, /api/teacher/content 200/401, /api/teacher/pdf 200/401 + %PDF magic), public /api/downloads/pdf. Note: chapter IDs are slugs (sound-systems, pirate-radio, hip-hop, house-techno, rave-culture, corporate-vs-real) — NOT numeric.
rca of the issue: No issues observed in this iteration.
